card.name: Words before life, fate, or circumstances nouns
card.fires_on: A linking or modifying word (and, personal, exact, their, without) in history, crime or biography text, where the next word is likely about a person's life, fate, or circumstances.

modes.label: Life and ...
modes.description: The word 'and' after 'Life' in a book title, before a word like Work or Times.
modes.example: title of which, at length, is the following: Life<< and>> Work at the Great Pyramid, by C

modes.label: Modifier before fate or welfare
modes.description: A modifier such as exact, their, personal or actual before a noun about a person's situation or identity.
modes.example: his<< exact>> resting place being now unknown.

modes.label: Outcome of a person
modes.description: A word leading into whether someone was harmed, robbed, or what happened to them.
modes.example: the perpetrators fled<< without>> robbing the victim

card.writes: It pushes toward words like circumstances and away from standing and alive.
card.plain: It fires on small words just before text about what became of a person or their life story.
